title: Adulting Like A Champ Workbook & Assessment
content:
Get The FREE

Adulting Like A Champ Assessment & Workbook

A Straightforward Planning Guide For Diverse Learners Transitioning Into Adulthood

Learn How To...

  • Unlock unique superpowers by self-assessing strengths, interests, preferences & more.
  • Use a simple but highly effective strategy for tackling BIG goals that increases follow through and decreases overwhelm.
  • Set goals in a scientifically-proven way that makes it 33% more likely they'll be achieved.
  • Think deeply about areas of strength and growth and use that information to drive goals forward.
  • Identify and home in on the lagging skills most important for achieving goals.

Full disclosure: by providing your email, you will be added to our weekly newsletter and receive emails from me when our blog is updated...but never spam. Unsubscribe anytime.

What People Are Saying...

Crystal I downloaded a copy of Adulting Like a Champ while working in the field of Developmental Services. I no longer work in that field BUT have given a copy of it to a former coworker so that it can be used to implement Personal Plans for the people who are supported.

Amy Understanding the importance of why learning these objectives will benefit us in the long run. Understanding that while we sometimes feel or think we are alone we are not alone. There are more people in our corner than what we thought. Understanding what I already know and am good at and what it is I need to learn or build up my skill level in. How to build SMART goals to better my life and keep it moving forward.

Krista BulgerParent & Teacher Love the SMART goal process page and example. Breaks it down and makes it easy to fill out each section by referring to the example.

About The Author

Hi there! I'm Chris and I created Adulting Like A Champ because it's my life's mission to help adolescents and young adults near and far find success in their transition to adulthood. Here's a little bit about me: I spent 8+ years as a special educator where I built a thriving life skills program and community internship program for students with diverse learning needs. I understand that there's no such thing as a one-size-fits-all system so this was a key consideration when creating Adulting LIke A Champ. My goal was to make it as flexible and adaptable as possible to target a variety of learning styles. I started Life Skills Advocate because I am extremely passionate about helping diverse learners beyond the classroom setting. Currently, I provide individualized job coaching, life coaching, academic support & community support for diverse learners across the greater Seattle area. I hope you find Adulting Like A Champ to be a very useful tool as you help your child or student reach their full potential :) Yours,

About The Author

Hi there! I'm Chris and I created Adulting Like A Champ because it's my life's mission to help adolescents and young adults near and far find success in their transition to adulthood.

Here's a little bit about me:

I spent 8+ years as a special educator where I built a thriving life skills program and community internship program for students with diverse learning needs.

I understand that there's no such thing as a one-size-fits-all system so this was a key consideration when creating Adulting LIke A Champ. My goal was to make it as flexible and adaptable as possible to target a variety of learning styles.

I started Life Skills Advocate because I am extremely passionate about helping diverse learners beyond the classroom setting. Currently, I provide individualized job coaching, life coaching, academic support & community support for diverse learners across the greater Seattle area.

I hope you find Adulting Like A Champ to be a very useful tool as you help your child or student reach their full potential :)
